summary: This is a prospectus supplement filed by Velo3D, Inc. under Rule 424(b)(5) for an at-the-market (ATM) equity offering of up to $100 million of its common stock. The filing details a Sales Agreement with Needham, Cantor, and Craig-Hallum as agents, with a 3.0% commission on gross proceeds. There is no stated price per share beyond the market price; the offering is continuous, with proceeds for general corporate purposes. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
